summary.text: Trojan whom Teucer brought down with his bow after Orsilochus — a namesake of Ormenus son of Amyntor in Phoenix's tale, of the Zacynthian suitor, and of other Ormenus figures in later myth.

story.text: Among the Trojans whom peerless Teucer slew when Ajax hid him with his shield stood Ormenus, laid on the bounteous earth beside Orsilochus and the warriors who followed in that deadly roll.
